resources.string: "Your playlists, guides, channels, groups and parental controls"
"How the guide looks and behaves while you\'re browsing"
"How Live TV shows up in the rest of Nuvio"
"The guide, its row on Home and everything else of Live TV\'s is off. It\'s switched on and off in Settings → Menu & Features."
"Your Google Drive backup is combined with this TV\'s setup and saved. Nothing is deleted from your Google Drive."

"You sign in to Google with a code on your phone. Your Google Drive backup is then combined with this TV\'s setup and saved. Nothing is deleted from your Google Drive, and this TV doesn\'t stay connected to it."
"This TV\'s setup is replaced with the copy saved before the last save."
"The saved copy is deleted and this TV stops syncing. This TV keeps its own setup."
"The copy in your Google Drive is replaced with this TV\'s Live TV setup."
"This TV stops syncing. Your backup stays in your Google Drive."
"Scan a QR code, then paste your playlist link, Xtream login or EPG link on your phone instead of typing it with the remote"
"Nothing included: turn on TV channels or movies & series under Edit"
"A channel list from the M3U link your provider gave you"
"Sign in with the server, username and password from your provider. Its TV guide comes with it."
"Use the portal URL and MAC address supplied by your provider"
"Extra TV listings from an XMLTV link (ending in .xml or .xml.gz). Guides linked in your playlists load by themselves."
"Downloads the latest channels and listings instead of waiting for the next automatic update"
"How often channel lists are downloaded again from your providers"
"How often TV listings are downloaded again"
"Show playlist, EPG and On Demand update progress. Updates continue in the background when hidden."
"Name cleanup, hidden channels and groups, your groups, resets"
"Tip: long-press a channel in the guide to rename, renumber, hide or favorite it. Long-press a group to rename, move or hide it."
"Words to take off the start or end of channel names, like USA, 24/7 or FHD, separated by commas"
"Take the same words off group names too, like \"| NL | Sports\""
"Channels you hid. Select one to show it again."
"Groups you hid. Select one to show it again."
"Groups you created. Select one to delete it."
"Every channel is taken out of Favorites."
"Puts back the names and numbers from your playlist"
"Every channel you renamed or renumbered goes back to its name and number from the playlist."
"Puts back the group names and order from your playlist"
"Renamed groups get their playlist names back, and the groups go back to the playlist\'s order."
"Every group goes back to its normal channel order."
"Takes out every channel you copied into another group. The originals stay."
"Every channel you copied into another group is taken out of it. The originals stay where they are."
"Channels you assigned a guide to go back to automatic matching"
"Every channel you assigned a guide to, or unassigned, goes back to automatic matching."
"The group list on the left of the guide"
"The group of channels you\'ve marked as favorites"
"The group of channels you watched last"
"The group with every channel in it"
"With more than one playlist, each playlist\'s groups sit under its own heading, which you can fold away"
"The number of channels next to each group"
"How the group list is sorted. Your order follows Reorder Groups; anything you haven\'t moved stays in playlist order."
"How channels are sorted in every group, Favorites included. Playlist order keeps your own order in Favorites and your groups."
"Replaces the playlist\'s numbers with each channel\'s place in the group: 20 favorites become 1 to 20"
"Movies and series from Xtream logins with movies & series switched on below."
"Imported. Updates once a day by itself."
"Not included. Switch on to import this provider\'s movies and series."
"How each group is sorted, unless you pick a sort for it in See all or Manage VOD Groups"
"Shows each movie or series once, even when your provider lists several copies (other qualities, categories or providers). Play lets you pick the version."
"Play on a title opened from On Demand starts your provider\'s copy right away. Off: Play shows every source, with your provider\'s as On Demand. Hold Play to see every source either way."
"Your addons\' posters where they have the title. Off: the provider\'s images only."
"Brings back every On Demand category you hid"
"Every On Demand category you hid comes back."
"What the guide shows and how much fits"
"The panel with the highlighted show\'s poster, title, time and description"
"The small video of the highlighted channel in the top-right corner"
"Shrinks the top of the guide to about two-thirds of its height, so more channels fit"
"How dark the info panel at the top and the bars in the guide are. Lightest lets more of the background show through. Darkest makes the text easiest to read."
"Posters for what\'s on, from your addons. Off: just the channel logo."
"Which playlist the highlighted channel comes from"
"The channel line at the top of the info panel"
"The small tags beside the channel name"
"How far into the show you are"
"Off: just numbers and logos, which leaves more room for the schedule"
"The number in front of each channel"
"The logo in front of each channel name"
"A red outline around the channel you\'re watching"
"Slimmer rows, slightly smaller text: about two more channels fit"
"Bigger text and rows: about three fewer channels fit"
"The biggest text and rows: about five fewer channels fit, and 1½ hours across"
"How big the text and rows in the guide are"
"Each show\'s start and end time under its title (rows get a little taller)"
"Episode numbers like \"S2 E5\" after show titles, in the guide, show info and the player"
"The line that marks the current time across the guide"
"4K, FHD, HD or SD next to channels you\'ve watched"
"Shows how smooth the channel is (25, 30, 50 or 60 FPS) next to the picture size while watching full screen. Handy for live sports."
"The backdrop behind the TV Guide and the Sports hub. Follows your color theme, or pick one of the app icon colors."
"How the selected show is marked: an outline, or filled with your theme color"
"Opening Live TV, changing channels, the info bar"
"Live TV opens on the group you last watched a channel in"
"Opening Live TV starts the channel you watched last in the preview window"
"The first time you open Live TV after starting the app, your last channel plays full screen"
"OK on a show goes straight to full screen, instead of playing it in the preview first"
"Land on Channel Names (Like a Cable Box)"
"Picking a group lands on the channel names: Up and Down change channel, OK plays, Right shows the schedule, Left goes back to the groups"
"Left while watching shows channels and schedules over the video. Off: Left goes back to the guide."
"Overlay: Keep List Open When Changing Channel"
"OK on another channel switches to it and the list stays open, so you can keep flicking through. OK on the playing channel or Back closes it."
"Overlay: Show Schedule and Details Beside the List"
"The highlighted channel\'s upcoming shows and what\'s on now, next to the channel list. Off: just the list; Right still opens them."
"Which channels Up and Down (or CH+ and CH−) step through while watching"
"Up / Down and CH+ / CH− show what\'s on other channels on the info bar without switching. What you\'re watching keeps playing until you press OK on the one you want. Back keeps you where you are."
"Up goes to the previous channel instead of the next one"

"Shortcuts under the play bar: press OK while watching, then Down. Pick its lists: Recently Watched (adult channels are never listed), Favorites and any of your groups. Also on the play bar: gear › Play bar layout."
"How dark the play bar is. Standard or Darkest makes the text easier to read over bright, busy pictures."
"How long the show info stays on screen after changing channel or pressing OK"
"The clock, frame rate, pausing and catch-up"
"A clock in the corner while you watch. With player controls: only on the info panel."
"Lower is more see-through, so it doesn\'t distract"
"A soft dark box behind the time, so it\'s easy to read on bright pictures"
"Turns captions on when a channel has them. You can still switch them off with CC."
"Sends Dolby audio untouched to your TV or speaker. Turn off if sound cuts out, especially with Echo speakers or Alexa Home Theater on Fire TV."
"Switches the TV to the video\'s frame rate (for example 50 Hz for UK and European channels) for smoother motion, on TVs that support it"
"On channels without catch-up, pausing records the channel to this device, so it carries on from where you paused"
"Full-screen channels keep a rolling recording, so you can skip back without pausing first (Left / Right once you\'re behind live, or from the panel). Channels take a second longer to start."
"How far back you can go. Saved to the drive set in Recordings, and deleted when you change channel or leave Live TV."
"Saves a replay to the device while you watch it, so rewinding and skipping ahead are instant instead of reloading. Uses about 35 MB a minute, deleted when you stop watching."
"Asks Xtream providers for replays in HLS (m3u8) first, so the seek bar works. Falls back to TS if the provider doesn\'t offer it."
"Catch-up time shift is set for each playlist: Playlists, then choose one."
"Larger rides out a slow connection or provider (fewer pauses); smaller changes channels a little faster. None: the closest to live and the quickest channel changes, but any hiccup shows as a pause"
"Tries the stream again by itself if it drops or freezes"
"How far into the future the guide keeps shows"
"How far back the guide keeps shows, for catch-up"
"Guide time shift is set for each guide: choose a playlist (its built-in guide) or an EPG source."
"Forgets the posters and show info found for Live TV, so they\'re looked up fresh from your addons"
"Live TV forgets every poster and show description it found. They\'re looked up again from your addons as you browse."
"The Live TV row inside Nuvio\'s home page, and the menu"
"Match your launcher\'s row: Wide for Google TV and most launchers, Tall for poster rows, Square for square rows. Each card shows the channel, what\'s on and until when."
"Live TV Row on the Home Screen"
"For this profile. Tucked above your top row: press Up to show it."
"Which channels appear: Favorites, Recently Watched, or one of your own groups"
"Your order, channel number, or the shows ending soonest first"
"Leaves out channels showing only \"Programming\" or no information"
"Off: OK plays the channel full screen. On: opens the guide with the channel playing."
"A \"Next: 9:00 The News\" line on each card"
"Just the logo and the show name"
"OK on a channel plays it behind the search results, to check it loads and how it looks. OK again opens it full screen."
"Your provider\'s copy offered with your addon streams for movies and episodes"
"Where its tab goes in the stream list, left to right after All"
"Only when its tab is first (and auto-play is set to use all sources)"
"Locked groups and categories need the PIN to open, and stay out of All Channels and search until unlocked."
"Locks groups and categories with names like Adult, XXX or 18+"
"Removes the PIN. Your locked groups are remembered."
"Set from a show\'s info in the guide. You get a message a minute before it starts."
"The chosen drive isn\'t plugged in: recordings go to this device until it\'s back"
"Where new recordings go. To move ones already recorded, hold OK on one in Recordings and choose Move To."
"Starts this long before the show, in case it begins early. Shows already set keep their times."
"Keeps going this long after the show, in case it runs over. Shows already set keep their times."
"The oldest recordings on that drive are deleted to make room"
"When space runs low, the oldest recordings on that drive will be deleted to make room for new ones."
"The last time the app crashed, froze or was closed. Scan the code with your phone to send it."
"What Live TV did while loading this time, how long it took, and anything that failed"
"What your addons return for a title"
"Enter your PIN to turn parental controls off"
"Its %1$s channels leave the guide. Favorites, hidden channels and EPG assignments for them are kept in case you add it back."
"Channels using this guide go back to other guides or automatic matching."
"Moves this playlist\'s built-in guide earlier or later, for listings out of step with what\'s playing"
"Moves this guide\'s listings earlier or later, for listings out of step with what\'s playing"
"If replays start the show before (or after) the one you picked, move the time asked for by that much. Example: it plays the show an hour earlier, set +1 h."
"Dark tint with a colored border — logos stay visible"
"You haven\'t made any groups yet. Long-press a channel in the guide and choose \"Add to group\"."
"Select a group to delete it. The channels stay in your playlist."
"Google Drive sync needs to be set up by whoever builds this app."
"Your playlists, guides, favorites, hidden channels and Live TV settings are saved in your own Google Drive, in a private app folder only this app can see. Nothing is stored anywhere else."
"Keeps your Live TV setup the same on every TV, using your own Google Drive. Sign in with a code on your phone."
"The Google account your Live TV setup is saved to"
"Back up changes, and pick up changes made on your other TVs"
"Save this TV\'s setup to Google Drive"
"Replace this TV\'s setup with the saved copy"
"Stop syncing on this TV (your backup stays in Drive)"
"Sign in to Nuvio to use it"
"Sign in to your Nuvio account (Settings → Account) and your Live TV setup follows you to every TV you sign in on. Nothing else to set up."

"Your playlists (including their logins), guides, favorites, Sports and Calendar choices and Live TV settings are saved and kept the same on every device you sign in on. Once it\'s on, you choose what\'s included."
"Save this TV\'s setup and keep every device the same"
"Bring your Google Drive backup over to this TV and save it"
"Keeps your playlists and settings the same on every device you sign in on."
"Changes also sync by themselves a few seconds after you make them"
"Go back to the copy saved before the last one"
"Stop syncing on this TV (the saved copy stays saved)"
"Remove the saved copy and stop syncing"
"Scan the QR code with your phone, or go to %1$s, then enter the code below and allow access."
"Waiting for you to allow access… this screen continues by itself."
"Added %1$s. It\'s loading on your TV now. You can add another."
"Connect this TV to your home Wi-Fi or network to add playlists from your phone."
"1. Put your phone on the same Wi-Fi as this TV.\n2. Scan the code with your phone\'s camera.\n3. Paste your playlist link, Xtream login or EPG link and tap Send to TV."
"Waiting for your phone… you can add more than one."
"Enter the full HTTP or HTTPS portal URL supplied by your provider."
"Enter the MAC address supplied by your provider."
"Only enter values supplied by your provider"
"Adds the provider\'s live channels to the TV guide"
"Adds the provider\'s movies and series to On Demand and to Nuvio\'s stream list"
"This TV\'s Live TV setup (playlists, guides, favorites and settings) is replaced with the copy in your Google Drive."
"This TV has changes made after that copy was saved. Restoring puts back the older playlists and logins. If this TV has the latest, press Back Up Now here instead."
"That copy is %1$s. If your playlists or logins have changed since (a new server address or password), press Back Up Now on a TV that has the latest first."
"Select an item to show it again."
"Up / Down to move it, OK to put it here"
"No camera? Type this on your phone: %1$s"

"If a channel won\'t play, switch to another channel with the same name from another group or playlist (like \"ESPN\" and \"ESPN Backup\"). During a live game, also when it keeps freezing, moving on to the next channel showing the game"

"Android itself hasn\'t found the drive. Check that the box shows it in its own settings (Storage). Large drives often need more power than a TV box\'s USB port gives: use a drive with its own power supply or a powered USB hub. The drive should be formatted as exFAT (NTFS is read only on many boxes, and FAT32 can\'t hold files over 4 GB). Don\'t set it up as \"device storage\": use it as removable storage."
"Your IPTV links, usernames and passwords. Stored encrypted."
"VPN configurations, selected profile and automatic protection scope."
"Favorite channels, hidden channels and group order."
"Followed teams and leagues, and Choose Leagues."
"How often lists and guides refresh, recording and catch-up options, sorting, search sources and Calendar choices. Not the look, so it is shared with your phone too."
"Themes, menu, card styles and other options, kept the same on your TVs. Turn off to keep each TV its own."
"The clock %1$s keeps its replays on. Automatic finds it from the provider. If replays play a different show, pick the time zone whose clock matches the provider\'s."
